coordinates.blender: Z up, initial front -Y, character left +X
coordinates.gltf: Y up, initial front +Z under frozen hierarchy; global basis (x,y,z) -> (x,z,-y)
coordinates.events: 30 fps source-frame timing: seconds=(frame-start_frame)/30. Preview endpoint holds change video duration, not animation duration.

runtime_boundary: Animation assets only. Apply complete root transform or extract correctly once; do not double-apply or reset displaced/turned endpoints. Measured root deltas are not gameplay-controller acceptance.

root_motion.horizontal: In place: no measured horizontal travel is specified in the sheet; stationary upward arrows interpreted as vertical jump.
root_motion.vertical: Continuous root translation, approximately 0.60 m takeoff-to-apex root rise; simultaneous bent-knee tuck adds clearance.

support_phases.support: both feet; knees absorb landing through frame 48

clips.start_end_use: Grounded lightly bent-knee guard; final six frames held stable. Same horizontal position.
